# Style guides

- **Code:** [docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md](../docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md) covers how we write code in this repository.
- **Git and pull requests:** [docs/GIT_WORKFLOW.md](../docs/GIT_WORKFLOW.md).
- **Writing:** the [Developer News Style Guide](https://w3develops.org/news/developer-news-style-guide) covers how to write articles, tutorials and posts for w3Develops. Its source is `src/app/news/developer-news-style-guide/page.tsx`.
